cards.headline: Trump says no hurry on Iran deal as Qatar pushes Hormuz plan
cards.summary: Trump said the US is not in that much of a hurry for an Iran deal while weighing new strikes after the midterms. Iran's foreign minister said Iran and Qatar have a plan to reopen Hormuz in two days if US meets conditions.
cards.why_it_matters: Hormuz shipping and a possible renewed US-Iran war affect oil and gasoline prices and the safety of US forces.

sources.title: Trump on Iran negotiations: ‘We’re not in that much of a hurry’
Iran war live: Tehran eyes 2-day Hormuz plan; Trump says talks ‘going fine’
Qataris hold marathon talks in Tehran in bid for U.S.-Iran deal before midterms

cards.headline: Iran's supreme leader orders maximum response to any US strike
cards.summary: Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei told top commanders any renewed US or Israeli attack must be met with an immediate response without geographical limits, according to a statement from his office. Iran's target list would be updated, he said.
cards.why_it_matters: Wider Iranian retaliation could put US troops, Gulf allies and global oil supplies at risk.

sources.title: Iran's supreme leader orders "maximum" response to any U.S. attack
Iranian supreme leader vows ‘unrestricted response’ to any US or Israeli strikes

cards.headline: More than 50 million Americans have voted early ahead of midterms
cards.summary: A record number of early votes have been cast three days before the Nov. 3 midterms. In states that report party data, Democrats outnumber Republicans among early voters, the Guardian reports. Many contests are tight.
cards.why_it_matters: Control of Congress will shape taxes, spending, immigration and oversight for the next two years.

sources.title: More than 50m Americans cast ballots in early voting with three days to go before midterms
Election cheat sheet: These early races could tell us where the midterms are headed

cards.headline: DOJ probes Alaska Senate ballot dispute over two Dan Sullivans
cards.summary: The Justice Department is seeking to isolate Alaska ballots amid a criminal probe of reports Democrats recruited a second Dan Sullivan candidate. Peltola and Democrats deny involvement; Alaska attorneys called a Trump-directed suit to halt certification meritless.
cards.why_it_matters: The outcome of a toss-up Senate race could affect Senate control and confidence in how disputes are handled.

sources.title: Justice Department seeks to isolate Alaska ballots amid criminal probe over Senate candidate
Peltola repeats denial of ballot-stacking reports, stays silent on federal probe
Attorneys for Alaska say ‘meritless’ Trump demand to set aside Senate ballots ‘not even possible’

cards.headline: Democratic feud erupts in Michigan Senate race days before vote
cards.summary: Democratic nominee Abdul El-Sayed asked Rep. Haley Stevens to stay away from his events, a source told NewsNation. A Clyburn adviser said El-Sayed cannot disinvite her from a Sunday unity event. Republican Mike Rogers claims an early-ballot lead.
cards.why_it_matters: Michigan is a close Senate contest, and party division could affect turnout in a race that may help decide control.

sources.title: El-Sayed campaign wants Stevens to stay away after day of back-and-forth sniping
Democrats’ self-inflicted wounds threaten high-stakes Michigan Senate race
Advisor to Clyburn says El-Sayed can't disinvite Stevens from unity event

cards.headline: Texas Senate race draws $500 million and national attention
cards.summary: BBC reports the state's roughly $500 million Senate race may be the most closely watched of the midterms. Democrat James Talarico drew a packed rally at Texas A&M, though it is unclear if he can win young voters.
cards.why_it_matters: A Democratic win in Texas would be a major upset and could tip Senate control.

sources.title: Democrats are used to heartbreak in Texas - could Talarico turn the tide?
Talarico draws a packed campus rally, but can he win over young voters?

cards.headline: Judges rebuff Trump DOJ on California ballots and election workers
cards.summary: A federal judge barred the administration from threatening election workers with prosecution over ballots from voters it calls ineligible. A 2–1 appeals panel rejected DOJ's bid to set aside California ballots; filings say many flagged voters were erroneously identified.
cards.why_it_matters: The rulings set rules for counting votes days before an election, amid DOJ claims of noncitizen voting that critics dispute.

sources.title: Judge blocks DOJ from threatening election workers before midterms
Trump DOJ loses last-minute California ballot bid
Federal judge blocks Trump DOJ's threats against election workers ahead of 2026 midterms

cards.headline: Judge dismisses Trump's $10 billion lawsuit against Wall Street Journal
cards.summary: A federal judge permanently threw out Trump's suit against the Journal and Rupert Murdoch over reporting on his ties to Jeffrey Epstein, ruling he failed to prove actual malice. Axios says it is the second court loss on the matter this year.
cards.why_it_matters: The ruling reinforces the high legal bar public figures face in libel cases against news outlets.

sources.title: Judge tosses Trump lawsuit against WSJ, Murdoch over Epstein story
Trump loses legal battle over Epstein-linked Wall Street Journal case

cards.headline: DC and Virginia sue to block construction of Trump's 250-foot arch
cards.summary: The District of Columbia and Virginia asked a federal court to block the planned arch, arguing it is unlawfully tall and would snarl traffic. The administration says construction is imminent. Judge Tanya Chutkin ordered both sides to agree on a briefing schedule.
cards.why_it_matters: The case tests federal power over landmarks and building rules in the capital region.

sources.title: Virginia and D.C. sue to block construction of Trump arch
Virginia and DC sue to stop Trump’s arch as government looks to start construction
D.C., Virginia sue to block Trump's 250-foot arch

cards.headline: Judge opens inquiry into DOJ conduct in golf course case
cards.summary: A federal judge opened a formal inquiry into whether Trump officials misled the court about plans to close the East Potomac municipal golf course for renovation. She questioned administration lawyers about what they knew.
cards.why_it_matters: Judges examining candor from government lawyers can shape how courts treat administration claims.

sources.title: Judge orders an inquiry into potential DOJ misconduct in Trump's golf course case
Judge investigating whether Trump administration lied about golf course renovations

cards.headline: Binance recovers 90% of $6.3bn hack losses; FBI blames North Korea
cards.summary: Binance says it has replaced 90% of assets stolen in a record $6.3 billion hack and plans to resume withdrawals Sunday. The FBI attributes the attack to North Korean state-backed group TraderTraitor.
cards.why_it_matters: Millions of crypto holders are affected, and stolen funds may finance North Korea's weapons programs.

sources.title: Binance says 90% of losses from $6.3bn hack covered as FBI says North Korea behind attack
Binance says 90% of $6.3 billion hack losses are now covered, plans to resume withdrawals Sunday
Why North Korea's 'elite' hackers are the prime suspect in major Binance hack

cards.headline: Tech earnings revive AI spending fears; stocks end week lower
cards.summary: Bloomberg says AI enthusiasm is collapsing after Big Tech earnings. CNBC reports stocks that started the week strongly ended in a reversal, with investors moving to defensive names. BBC notes AI spending nearing $1 trillion.
cards.why_it_matters: AI stocks anchor many 401(k)s and index funds, so a sustained pullback touches retirement savings.

sources.title: AI Enthusiasm Is Collapsing and Tech Earnings Just Made It Worse
Stocks started the week with promise but ended in despair. Our take on the big reversal
US tech stocks see sharp falls as AI spending nears $1tn

cards.headline: Intel has its worst day since the 1970s
cards.summary: Intel shares fell sharply, wiping about $12 billion off the US government's stake. TechCrunch says PC sales are hurt as AI demand for memory and components raises PC prices.
cards.why_it_matters: The government is a major Intel shareholder, and higher PC prices hit consumers and businesses.

sources.title: Intel stock has worst day since 1970s, wiping about $12 billion off government's stake
Intel’s stock crashes, knocking $12B from government’s stake

cards.headline: S&P turns negative on Meta over cash flow and capex
cards.summary: S&P Global Ratings revised Meta's outlook to negative, citing heavy capital spending and concerns about free cash flow.
cards.why_it_matters: Debt-funded AI spending by a megacap raises questions about whether the AI boom is financially sustainable.

sources.title: Meta outlook revised downward by S&P on cash flow and capex concerns

cards.headline: OpenAI pares fundraising goal to as much as $20 billion
cards.summary: OpenAI is now seeking up to $20 billion in its latest round, a person familiar told CNBC. The round has not closed and figures may change. TechCrunch says it does not appear to be meeting expectations.
cards.why_it_matters: A scaled-back raise from the AI leader is a signal on investor appetite for costly AI buildouts.

sources.title: OpenAI pares fundraising goal, now seeking up to $20 billion in latest round
OpenAI reportedly lowers funding target for new round

cards.headline: Anthropic expected to get high-yield credit rating after IPO
cards.summary: The FT reports, per TechCrunch, that Blackstone expects credit agencies to give Anthropic a high junk rating following its IPO. The forecast is a prediction, and such a rating would raise borrowing costs.
cards.why_it_matters: Financing costs for leading AI labs affect how fast AI tools reach consumers and businesses.

sources.title: Anthropic expected to receive high ‘junk’ rating from credit agencies following IPO, FT report says

cards.headline: Tainted Claude extension hit thousands of developer machines
cards.summary: A supply chain attack put malicious Anthropic Claude extensions on thousands of devices. Wired says flawed code stopped the attacker from fully compromising about 5,000 machines. Ars reports the Cursor extension was backdoored for nearly 12 hours.
cards.why_it_matters: Developer tools are a growing attack route into company and government systems.

sources.title: A Supply Chain Attack Put Malicious Anthropic Claude Extensions on Thousands of Devices
Anthropic VS code extension on Cursor backdoored for nearly 12 hours

cards.headline: Judge lets NAACP pollution suit over xAI data center proceed
cards.summary: A judge denied a bid to dismiss an NAACP lawsuit alleging Clean Air Act violations at xAI's Colossus data centers and power plant near Memphis. The company is now part of SpaceX.
cards.why_it_matters: Pollution rules may shape where and how fast AI data centers are built in US communities.

sources.title: SpaceX loses bid to toss NAACP lawsuit over Memphis data center air pollution
Judge allows NAACP lawsuit over xAI data center pollution to move forward

cards.headline: Data centers become a midterm issue from Brooklyn to West Virginia
cards.summary: TechCrunch says AI and data centers dominated talk at a Brooklyn midterm event. NPR reports West Virginia residents are fighting a project spanning thousands of acres near the Monongahela National Forest.
cards.why_it_matters: Local power, land and utility-bill fights over data centers are reaching voters.

sources.title: Data centers are now a midterm issue, even in Brooklyn
Plans for a data center threaten scenic wilderness and dark skies in West Virginia

cards.headline: French cost-of-living protests enter a third week; Germany sees violence
cards.summary: More than 320,000 people marched across France on Saturday, mostly peacefully, with clashes in Paris and Marseille. Protests in German cities including Berlin, Hamburg and Frankfurt turned violent, with shops looted, BBC reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Unrest in two of Europe's largest economies could weigh on growth, markets and US allies' stability.

sources.title: Shops looted as German cost of living protests turn violent
Police clash with masked rioters after largely peaceful protests across France
France seethes again as youth-led protests sweep Europe

cards.headline: Poland's constitutional court standoff deepens
cards.summary: Police were deployed after the government suspended two senior justices and moved toward criminal charges. Prime Minister Tusk defends the overhaul, saying some matters allow no compromise; the president held crisis talks.
cards.why_it_matters: A rule-of-law fight in a key NATO and EU member tests European unity.

sources.title: Police deployed during stand-off over control of top Poland court
Tusk defends overhaul of Poland’s constitutional court despite protests
Polish president holds crisis talks in court standoff

cards.headline: US approves sale of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine
cards.summary: The US greenlit 500 Patriot interceptors for Ukraine, with $2.1 billion to be paid by allies. Breaking Defense notes it follows tensions over purported delays in interceptor transfers.
cards.why_it_matters: Patriots are the main defense against Russian ballistic missiles, and allies rather than US taxpayers are footing much of the bill.

sources.title: US approves sale of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine
US greenlights 500 Patriot missiles for Ukraine, with $2.1 billion to be paid by allies

cards.headline: Oleshky evacuees reach Ukraine during local US-brokered truce
cards.summary: Hundreds of residents of Russian-occupied Oleshky crossed into Ukrainian-held territory Saturday during a localized ceasefire. The Hill says it was brokered by first lady Melania Trump. Evacuees described lacking food, water and power.
cards.why_it_matters: A rare humanitarian truce shows what limited US-brokered deals are possible while broader talks stall.

sources.title: Oleshky evacuees reunite with families after truce allows crossing back into Ukraine
Evacuees from Russia-controlled Oleshky arrive back in Ukraine amid U.S.-brokered ceasefire
Evacuees from Russian-occupied city arrive in Ukraine

cards.headline: G20 ministers' family photo cancelled over Russia's presence
cards.summary: The US cancelled the traditional photo at the G20 foreign ministers' meeting in Atlanta after about a third of countries, including the UK and Australia, threatened to boycott over Russia. EU's Kallas warned against hosting Putin at December's summit.
cards.why_it_matters: The US is hosting a G20 split over Russia, with Washington balancing Ukraine pressure and diplomacy with Moscow.

sources.title: US cancels G20 ‘family photo’ after Australia, UK and others refuse to appear with Russia
G20 'family photo' cancelled after protests over presence of Russian minister
EU’s Kallas Says Hosting Putin at G20 May Normalize War Crimes

cards.headline: Canada and EU launch new alliance open to other countries
cards.summary: At a Montreal summit, Canada and the European Union announced an Alliance for the Future, open to like-minded nations, described as a protective canopy for citizens and a hedge against global turbulence.
cards.why_it_matters: Two close US partners are building ties beyond Washington, a sign of shifting trade and security alignments.

sources.title: Canada and EU announce new alliance open to like-minded countries
Starmer says UK must get closer to Europe as US relationship changes

cards.headline: Quebec paper mill closed indefinitely after 50% US tariffs
cards.summary: A century-old paper mill in Témiscaming, Quebec has closed indefinitely after the US imposed 50% tariffs on its products, putting hundreds out of work, BBC reports.
cards.why_it_matters: It shows the cost of US tariffs for Canadian communities and for American buyers of paper products.

sources.title: The fight to save Canadian town threatened by Trump's tariffs

cards.headline: Rubio says US did not help Bolsonaro flee Brazil
cards.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the administration did not help Jair Bolsonaro leave Brazil for the US. Trump said Bolsonaro, who faces investigation in Brazil, can stay in the US as long as he wants.
cards.why_it_matters: The case strains US-Brazil relations and raises questions about US treatment of foreign figures facing prosecution.

sources.title: Rubio says Trump administration did not help Bolsonaro flee Brazil to US

cards.headline: Bolivia declares emergency as El Niño drought hits farmers
cards.summary: Drought is affecting 78,000 families and has killed more than 75,000 cattle in Bolivia, which declared a state of emergency. El Niño is due to peak in late 2026.
cards.why_it_matters: El Niño can shift weather and crop prices worldwide, including food costs for US consumers.

sources.title: Bolivia declares state of emergency over El Nino weather pattern

cards.headline: India opposition rally demands election chief resign over voter rolls
cards.summary: Security was tightened in Delhi before a large opposition march demanding the election chief resign. Protesters fear a voter roll revision could leave 130 million voters off the rolls.
cards.why_it_matters: Voting rights disputes in the world's most populous democracy matter to a key US partner.

sources.title: India's opposition set to hold mega rally seeking election chief's resignation
Indian forces tighten security in Delhi ahead of big opposition protest

cards.headline: China's Communist Party meeting focuses on discipline ahead of Xi's bid
cards.summary: This week's central committee meeting in Beijing focused on discipline and fighting corruption, NPR reports. It comes before next year, when Xi Jinping is widely expected to seek a fourth term.
cards.why_it_matters: Xi's consolidation of power shapes China's approach to trade, Taiwan and tech rivalry with the US.

sources.title: Key takeaways from this week's political meeting in Beijing

cards.headline: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo passes 5,000 deaths; Nigeria probes cases
cards.summary: Government data show more than 10,000 infections and over 5,000 deaths in DR Congo's deadliest Ebola outbreak. Nigeria is investigating two suspected cases in the northeast, with contact tracing and testing under way.
cards.why_it_matters: Spread beyond Congo would raise travel and public health concerns globally.

sources.title: More than 5,000 die from Ebola in DR Congo's deadliest outbreak
Health authorities probe two suspected Ebola cases in northeast Nigeria

cards.headline: Screwworm spreads to a third US state and attacks pets
cards.summary: USDA has identified 74 animal cases in the US since the parasitic flies invaded in June. Four dogs and a cat were attacked this week, Ars Technica reports.
cards.why_it_matters: The parasite threatens livestock and pets and could hit the US cattle industry and beef prices.

sources.title: Flesh-eating screwworms spread to third state and are attacking pets

cards.headline: Global nature talks reach a deal but funding gap remains
cards.summary: Countries reached an agreement to get a global effort to halt nature decline back on track, but money remains an unresolved issue, BBC reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Biodiversity loss affects food, water and economic security worldwide.

sources.title: Global nature talks reach deal but money remains an issue

cards.headline: Germany misses winter gas storage target
cards.summary: Germany failed to meet its winter gas storage target and will have to rely on more spot-market purchases, the FT reports. That could raise prices for other EU countries.
cards.why_it_matters: Higher European gas prices can push up global energy costs and strain allies' economies.

sources.title: Germany fails to meet Winter gas storage target

cards.headline: Oil majors resist building refineries as fuel prices keep rising
cards.summary: Conflicts in the Middle East and Ukraine have cut fuel production capacity and lifted margins, but the FT reports oil majors are resisting pressure to invest in new refineries. Russia also extended its diesel export ban through January.
cards.why_it_matters: Tight refining capacity keeps diesel and gasoline prices elevated for US drivers and shippers.

sources.title: Oil majors resist pressure to invest in new refineries as fuel prices keep rising
Russia Extends Ban on Most Diesel Exports Through January

cards.headline: Economy sends mixed signals before midterms as bond investors pause
cards.summary: NPR says GDP growth is up but so are prices, and interest rates are staying the same for now. The FT reports big bond fund managers are pressing pause ahead of the vote and economic data.
cards.why_it_matters: Prices and borrowing costs are top voter concerns and will shape policy after Tuesday.

sources.title: Mixed economic forecast weighs heavy ahead of midterms
Bond investors sit out ‘most consequential’ US midterm elections in years

cards.headline: Turkey names new market regulator after investment fund crisis
cards.summary: President Erdogan appointed Muhsin Atci, head of the tax inspection board, to lead Turkey's market regulator after an investment fund crisis rocked financial markets.
cards.why_it_matters: Turkish market turmoil can spill into emerging-market assets held by US investors.

sources.title: Turkey Appoints New Top Market Regulator in Fund Crisis Response

cards.headline: Crypto industry spends over $200 million on 2026 midterms
cards.summary: Groups tied to cryptocurrency are spending more than $200 million to influence the midterms and press Congress for favorable rules, CNBC reports. They had mixed success in 2024.
cards.why_it_matters: The outcome could shape how crypto is regulated and taxed in the US.

sources.title: Crypto industry pours more than $200 million into 2026 midterms to pressure Congress on favorable rules

cards.headline: New York teen's killing prompts visa for his mother, Mamdani says
cards.summary: Mayor Zohran Mamdani said Trump agreed to grant a visa to the mother of Javits Frimpong, a 15-year-old from Ghana shot in the Bronx Thursday. Thousands have attended vigils.
cards.why_it_matters: It is a human story that touches youth violence and immigration processes in New York.

sources.title: Trump to grant visa to mother of teen killed in Bronx shooting, Mamdani says
The murder of Javits Frimpong, a bullied schoolboy in The Bronx

cards.headline: ICE agent charged after hitting Texas immigrant with vehicle
cards.summary: An ICE agent was charged for striking a Mexican national with a vehicle during a pursuit, causing multiple leg fractures and a hip injury, prosecutors said.
cards.why_it_matters: Criminal charges against a federal immigration agent are unusual and bear on enforcement accountability.

sources.title: ICE agent charged for hitting Texas immigrant with vehicle during pursuit

cards.headline: FDA seeks to pull approval of Tavneos over manipulated study data
cards.summary: The FDA says Tavneos was approved on the basis of manipulated study data, but Ars Technica reports withdrawing a drug is not easy and raises questions about patients' access.
cards.why_it_matters: The case tests how the FDA handles drugs approved on flawed evidence while patients depend on them.

sources.title: The FDA wants to pull its approval of a drug. It’s not so easy.

cards.headline: NASA asks for ideas to rescue Hubble from orbital decay
cards.summary: NASA is again soliciting ideas to reboost the Hubble Space Telescope, four years after a previous request produced no result, Ars Technica reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Hubble is a flagship US science asset facing eventual loss without a boost.

sources.title: Once again, NASA is asking for ideas to rescue Hubble from certain death

cards.headline: Salesforce reportedly buys defense AI startup Rune for $375 million
cards.summary: Salesforce is reportedly acquiring Rune, an AI logistics startup, to bolster its Missionforce defense platform, TechCrunch reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Business software companies are pushing into defense contracting.

sources.title: Salesforce’s M&A spree continues with a reported $375M deal for defense tech startup Rune

cards.headline: Apple CEO says company won't ship AI for AI's sake
cards.summary: Apple's new CEO defended the company's position in the AI landscape, saying it does not want to ship AI for AI's sake, TechCrunch reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Apple's cautious approach affects what AI features reach hundreds of millions of US iPhone users.

sources.title: Apple CEO says the company doesn’t ‘want to ship AI for AI’s sake’

cards.headline: Medicare AI pre-approval test leads to drop in medical services
cards.summary: Medicare is testing AI to conduct prior authorizations to target wasteful spending, and MarketWatch reports it immediately led to a large drop in medical services.
cards.why_it_matters: It raises the question of whether AI cuts waste or restricts needed care for seniors.

sources.title: Medicare used AI to pre-approve patient care, and it immediately led to a large drop in medical services

cards.headline: AI agent performs gene therapy injection on a live mouse
cards.summary: A biotech startup let an AI agent choose a gene therapy and inject it into a live mouse's brain, Wired reports, offering a glimpse of automated research labs.
cards.why_it_matters: Automated labs could speed up drug research, and raise safety and oversight questions.

sources.title: An AI Agent Injected Drugs Into a Live Mouse’s Brain

cards.headline: Golden State Valkyries win first WNBA title
cards.summary: The Valkyries beat the Atlanta Dream to win their first WNBA championship. Gabby Williams was named Finals MVP after setting records for points and steals in the WNBA Finals.
cards.why_it_matters: A young expansion team's title marks a milestone for the growing women's league.

sources.title: Golden State Valkyries defeat Atlanta Dream to capture first WNBA crown
